providers.name: Bursary Assessment Associates (BAA)
providers.description: Independent bursary assessor using its Secure Apply portal, validation and interview/meeting process.
providers.reuse: Yes. BAA states that where it handles all relevant schools, families can enter multiple school codes; with family and school agreement it may conduct a single meeting and assessment for multiple client schools.
providers.parentFee: Usually commissioned by the school; BAA says families cannot appoint it independently.

providers.name: Bursary Administration Ltd (BAL)
providers.description: Independent bursary assessment service providing financial reviews, home visits/online assessments and reports to schools.
providers.reuse: No general public multi-school promise located yet. Ask each BAL school to authorise reuse of an existing current-year assessment before paying or repeating interviews.
providers.parentFee: Varies by school; the school may pay or may pass on an assessment charge.

providers.name: Applicaa
providers.description: Application-platform provider. A school using an Applicaa bursary portal is not, by itself, evidence that Applicaa makes the financial decision or performs an independent means assessment.
providers.reuse: Treat as a portal unless the school's policy names a separate assessor.
providers.parentFee: Not normally a parent-commissioned bursary assessment.

schools.name: St Martin's School, Northwood
schools.awardRange: Up to 90%; school says awards are likely to be 25%, 50% or 80%
schools.meansTest: Household income and capital with full documentary evidence; financial, compassionate and other pertinent circumstances may be considered.
schools.reuseNote: No published multi-school reuse mechanism identified.
schools.strategyNote: Useful reminder not to screen yourself out purely on headline salary: the published policy does not state a simple income ceiling.

schools.name: North London Collegiate School
schools.awardRange: Means-tested; verify current maximum with school
schools.meansTest: Income, expenditure, assets and liabilities under the school's policy.
schools.reuseNote: Can potentially share one BAA application/meeting with other BAA client schools.
schools.strategyNote: Add all participating BAA school codes at the outset where permitted.

schools.name: Merchant Taylors' School, Northwood
schools.awardRange: Means-tested; verify current maximum with school
schools.meansTest: Detailed household financial circumstances under school policy.
schools.reuseNote: Ask the school and BAL whether another current BAL assessment can be reused.
schools.strategyNote: Do not duplicate a BAL interview/document review until reuse has been explicitly ruled out.

schools.name: Harrow School
schools.assessmentRoute: School may involve BAL; home visit may be required
schools.meansTest: Suitability, parental financial circumstances and available funding; detailed financial review.
schools.reuseNote: Ask whether an existing BAL report can be accepted.
schools.strategyNote: Plan for a home visit and school-specific review even if BAL evidence can be reused.

schools.name: Mill Hill School
schools.assessmentRoute: School-led financial statement and committee review
schools.meansTest: Household financial circumstances under Foundation policy.
schools.reuseNote: Separate unless Mill Hill agrees to accept an external report as supporting evidence.
schools.strategyNote: Ask whether a BAA/BAL report can replace any part of the evidence-gathering process.

schools.name: Westminster School
schools.assessmentRoute: School financial assessment; may include home/virtual visit
schools.meansTest: Detailed household financial circumstances and assets.
schools.reuseNote: Treat as a separate process unless Westminster confirms otherwise.
schools.strategyNote: Budget time for a school-specific two-stage process.

schools.name: Winchester College
schools.meansTest: Household financial circumstances under college policy.
schools.reuseNote: No shared external-assessor route currently recorded.
schools.strategyNote: Ask whether external reports can be submitted as supporting evidence.

schools.name: John Lyon School
schools.assessmentRoute: Published means-test guidance; current assessor not yet confirmed
schools.meansTest: Income, property, savings, investments, pensions and other assets.
schools.reuseNote: Confirm assessor before starting the form.
schools.strategyNote: Provider identification is a research gap; resolve before duplicating another assessment.

schools.name: Haberdashers' Boys' School
schools.awardRange: Means-tested; award level depends on need and available funds
schools.assessmentRoute: BAL reviews shortlisted bursary applicants; call and possibly home visit
schools.deadline: Apply as part of registration by the school's published bursary deadline
schools.meansTest: All parents with parental responsibility complete financial information. Published policy says applicants with assessed total household gross income over £150,000 will not be called for bursary interview.
schools.reuseNote: Ask Habs and BAL whether a current BAL assessment from another school can be reused.
schools.strategyNote: £150,000 is a published ceiling for interview consideration, but income below it does not guarantee an award; assets and visible wealth are also considered.

schools.name: Highgate School
schools.awardRange: Up to 100% of fees; additional support may include uniform, IT and trips
schools.assessmentRoute: BAA financial assessment and online meeting for shortlisted bursary candidates
schools.meansTest: Income, outgoings, assets, liabilities, value/council-tax band of home and family size. Guide: under £45,000 with no significant assets may receive 100%; £45,000–£107,000 may receive partial support.
schools.reuseNote: Strong candidate for BAA multi-school reuse with NLCS and any other BAA client schools in the same cycle.
schools.strategyNote: Keyworker bursary guidance extends consideration up to £125,000 household income. Academic selection is separate, but performance is considered in deciding who receives limited bursary places.

schools.name: St Paul's School
schools.awardRange: 2%–100% of fees, with the same percentage support for many extras
schools.assessmentRoute: Formal school financial assessment after the applicant makes sufficient academic progress
schools.deadline: Varies by 7+, 11+, 13+ and 16+ entry; flag bursary on registration
schools.meansTest: Published guide: gross household income up to £144,000 and net assets up to £1.6m may be eligible. Below £78,000 may be eligible for up to 100%, subject to assets. £15,000 income allowance per additional dependent child.
schools.reuseNote: No BAA/BAL provider identified in current school guidance; treat as separate unless school confirms otherwise.
schools.strategyNote: One of the clearest examples showing that relatively high income does not automatically rule out assistance when household assets and dependants are considered.

schools.name: City of London School
schools.awardRange: Up to 100% of fees plus extras at 11+ and 16+
schools.assessmentRoute: Two-stage financial assessment followed, in many cases, by a home visit
schools.deadline: 11+ 2027 registration: 2 November 2026; Stage 1: 10 November; Stage 2: 14 December
schools.meansTest: All income, essential expenditure, assets and liabilities. School does not publish a single hard income threshold and prioritises cases where support would be most transformational.
schools.reuseNote: Treat as school-specific; no external BAA/BAL assessor named in current guidance.
schools.strategyNote: The school deliberately screens finances in stages before asking for the full evidence pack, which reduces wasted work for clearly ineligible families.

schools.name: City of London Freemen's School
schools.assessmentRoute: BAL independent review via school bursary portal
schools.meansTest: Income, expenditure and assets; awards reviewed annually.
schools.reuseNote: Ask BAL/Freemen's whether a current-year BAL review can be shared with another BAL school.
schools.strategyNote: Deadline is comparatively early, so it belongs near the top of the planner even if entrance assessments occur later.

schools.name: Latymer Upper School
schools.providerName: External assessor appointed by Latymer (name not published on current page)
schools.assessmentRoute: External confidential bursary assessment; shortlisted families may then be visited by senior staff
schools.deadline: Apply alongside registration; verify current-year date
schools.meansTest: No strict published cut-off on the current school page; considers income, outgoings, property, savings and factors affecting ability to work.
schools.reuseNote: Identify the current external assessor before submitting; if BAA/BAL, cluster with matching schools.
schools.strategyNote: Do not self-reject on salary alone. Latymer explicitly says it looks at families individually rather than applying a strict income-only rule.

schools.name: University College School (UCS)
schools.assessmentRoute: Current external/in-house assessor not yet verified
schools.meansTest: Full household means assessment; current detailed criteria to verify.
schools.reuseNote: Resolve provider before starting another financial assessment.
schools.strategyNote: Keep as a research-gap record so the planner visibly prompts provider verification rather than silently assuming a separate process.

schools.name: King's College School, Wimbledon
schools.assessmentRoute: External financial assessment; home visit may be requested
schools.meansTest: Household income, expenditure, assets and liabilities; award individually assessed.
schools.reuseNote: Potential BAL cluster with Habs, Merchant Taylors' and City of London Freemen's if schools authorise report reuse.
schools.strategyNote: Contact BAL/school before repeating the evidence review or home-visit process.
